identity.description: Linear dimensionality reduction via SVD of the (centered) data matrix: finds the orthogonal directions of maximum variance and projects rows onto the top k. Captures second-order (linear/covariance) structure only; the fitted linear map is reusable on new rows and the loadings are directly inspectable.

consumes.note: unsupervised — no target; strictly numeric matrix (linear algebra on the centered data)

emits.note: the projected component scores (n_rows × k); the standard reduce-then-model handoff. Inverse transform (reconstruction back to feature space) is exact-on-the-subspace and native

components_ — the (k × features) loadings matrix, i.e. the fitted linear map's weights; plus explained_variance_ratio_ per component. portTypeProposal: loadings ride the 'coefficients' port as the nearest existing per-model parameter-block port; if U2 splits parameter blocks by shape, a dedicated 'loadings' port would be the cleaner name

n_components.note: int = fixed component count; float in (0,1) = retain that fraction of variance (k chosen at fit); the variance-retained form is the safer pipeline default

whiten.note: rescales scores to unit component variance — matters when a scale-sensitive model consumes the embedding

svd_solver.note: a compute choice, not a fit choice; 'randomized' is seeded (random_state) so fits stay reproducible — sign of each component is made deterministic by svd_flip either way

invariances.why: the objective is variance maximization — a feature's raw variance directly sets its pull on the components, so unstandardized units let the biggest-unit feature own PC1
covariance is not preserved under nonlinear monotone maps — log/rank a feature and the eigenstructure changes
the SVD of the centered data matrix is undefined with missing entries — fit raises on NaN
eigen-decomposition needs a numeric matrix; categorical levels have no covariance until encoded

the SVD is distribution-free; Gaussianity only matters for probabilistic add-ons (PPCA likelihoods), not the decomposition itself — the real assumption is that LINEAR structure is the structure worth keeping
closed-form fit with no optimization loop; usable from tens of rows, though component directions are noisy when n is small relative to p (at most min(n,p) components exist)
the fitted projection is a linear map defined on all of feature space — out-of-range rows project cleanly (their reconstruction error just grows off-subspace)

featureStats.why: PCA's compression payoff is exactly the eigenvalue decay of the correlation matrix — fast decay means few components carry most variance; a flat spectrum means there is nothing linear to compress
the ratio of largest to smallest feature variance is the scale-sensitivity trap made measurable — high disparity without upstream standardization means PC1 is just the biggest-unit column
components only merge information features share; near-orthogonal features give an identity-like rotation and dimensionality reduction discards signal instead of redundancy

modelMetrics.why: the direct scoreboard of the variance-maximization objective — how much second-order structure the kept subspace preserves at the chosen k
mean squared error of inverse-transformed rows is the complementary view: high error at the chosen k means the linear-subspace assumption is dropping real signal

edgeCases.condition: NaN anywhere in the input matrix
edgeCases.behavior: fit raises — SVD undefined on missing entries
sklearn raises ValueError — no such subspace exists
get zero loading weight; upstream standardization of them divides by zero first
variance is outlier-dominated, so components rotate to chase a handful of rows
edgeCases.note: robust-scale or de-skew upstream before trusting the directions

driver.wrapperNeeds: none (fit/transform/inverse_transform; components_ + explained_variance_ratio_ exposed post-fit for the loadings emission)
driver.threadSafety: fit runs on BLAS threads; transform is thread-safe

placementClaims.why: no native NaN path — the SVD needs a complete matrix
de-skewing heavy-tailed features reduces outlier leverage on the variance directions (variance is a squared-error quantity)
variance-based objective: without standardization the components track raw measurement units, not shared structure
strictly numeric linear algebra — categoricals must be encoded before covariance means anything
